Package com.squad93.pos.ui

Class ManagerSection

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
com.squad93.pos.ui.ManagerSection
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
EmployeeView, InventoryView, MenuView, ReportsView, SalesReportView
abstract class ManagerSection extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Base layout and asynchronous task handling for manager screens. Call its UI helpers on the JavaFX application thread. Repository work runs on the supplied executor, and completion handlers update the scene graph on the JavaFX thread.
Author:
Tejas Kalpathi

  • Method Details

    • refresh

      abstract void refresh()
      Requests fresh data for this section from the JavaFX application thread. Implementations use run(String, Callable, Consumer) to avoid blocking the UI.

    • run

      protected <T> void run(String progress, Callable<T> work, Consumer<T> success)
      Runs work in the background while disabling section controls and showing progress. Calls made while another operation is running are ignored. On success, controls are re-enabled before the callback runs, so that callback can request a refresh. Failures retain the current content and display the exception message with refresh guidance.
      Type Parameters:
      T - background result type
      Parameters:
      progress - status shown during execution
      work - blocking operation that must not read or mutate scene-graph controls
      success - callback invoked with the result on the JavaFX application thread

    • edit

      protected static <T> Optional<T> edit(String title, javafx.scene.Node fields, Supplier<T> read)
      Shows a modal save dialog that retains invalid input and displays validation messages. The supplier runs on the JavaFX thread; repository writes belong in a later background task.
      Type Parameters:
      T - validated form result type
      Parameters:
      title - dialog title and heading
      fields - form controls to show
      read - supplier that reads the controls and throws IllegalArgumentException for invalid input
      Returns:
      the validated result, or an empty optional when cancelled

      Reads a required text value after trimming surrounding whitespace.
      Parameters:
      field - the input field
      name - the field name used in validation messages
      Returns:
      the trimmed value
      Throws:

    • decimal

      protected static BigDecimal decimal(javafx.scene.control.TextField field, String name, int scale)
      Parses a nonnegative decimal without rounding and enforces the supported precision. Precision is limited to 10 digits for scale 2, and 12 digits for other scales.
      Parameters:
      field - the numeric input field
      name - the field name used in validation messages
      scale - the required decimal scale
      Returns:
      the parsed value at the requested scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parsing, scale, sign, or precision validation fails
